product_one_liner.value: voize converts caregivers' spoken notes into structured electronic health record documentation for nurses and care teams in long-term care and skilled nursing facilities.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes pricing based on the number of people receiving care and offers a quote request.

employee_band.notes: Y Combinator lists a team size of 140.

eng_blog.notes: Includes CTO Erik Ziegler's post on on-device PyTorch inference and ML Engineer Reuben Morais's post on Kubernetes/OpenTelemetry monitoring.

public_docs.notes: Public German-language help center with multiple product-help collections and numerous articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Senior ML Engineer - NLP (m/f/d) has a live application link.

model_provider.notes: Its ML engineering posting states that it uses Claude through its inference service, alongside open and on-device models.

compliance_certs.notes: These are public compliance claims. voize explicitly states that it is not yet ISO 27001 or SOC 2 certified.

last_funding.notes: Announced on 17 November 2025 and led by Balderton Capital.

raised_18mo.notes: The $50 million Series A announced on 17 November 2025 falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Sales Development Representative (m/f/d) - SaaS has a live application link.

launched_6mo.notes: On 22 September 2026, voize and Dedalus announced an ORBIS integration enabling bedside voice capture and structured transfer of nursing documentation into ORBIS U.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A VP Engineering profile lists a September 2026 start at voize, within the requested 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Growth Marketing Manager posting requires HubSpot knowledge, including workflows, lead scoring, lifecycle stages, nurture programs and reporting.
